exposure: timing of elective cesarean section (early term vs. >=39 weeks)
cohort: The study included maternal and neonatal information from all elective cesarean sections performed in singleton pregnancies at >=370 weeks gestation over a 20-year period.
finding: Of elective cesarean sections performed before 39-week gestation, two-thirds were done without a clear medical indication, thereby exposing the newborn to an increased risk of respiratory morbidity.
mod_finding: Neonates delivered by elective cesarean section at 370-386 weeks gestation had a higher rate of respiratory morbidity (5.7%) compared to those delivered at 390-421 weeks gestation (2.4%).
gest_age: >=370 weeks gestation, with comparisons between 370-386 weeks and 390-421 weeks.
